title: BIG IF TRUE #001 — Southern Europe has stopped cooling down at night: code and data
description: Code and shared data behind the BIG IF TRUE article on summer nights in southern Europe (English and Italian editions). check_numbers.py recomputes every number the article prints from the shared data (64 checks); the figure scripts redraw all six figures, in both languages, from the shared data. Hours of relief: of the eight coldest hours of each month's average daily cycle, how many stay below 20 °C; June–August, 1980–1989 against 2020–2025, ERA5-Land at 0.1°, population-weighted with Eurostat's 2021 census grid.
notes: Code written by Claude (Anthropic) under the author's direction: Claude Opus 5 and Claude Opus 5.5 in a regular Claude chat (analysis and writing), Claude Sonnet 5.5 in Claude Code (repository). Usage in USAGE.md: Claude Code measured; the chat's cost is unknown because a regular Claude chat keeps no token record.
